atoms.text: The Tripitaka are the texts sacred to Buddhists. The Tripitaka contain the words and teachings of the Buddha, the founder of Buddhism. Buddhists read the Tripitaka to receive guidance and to learn how to reach peace of mind and feel a sense of unity with all living things and all people.

atoms.text: The Shastras are the texts sacred to Hindus. There are two main parts to the Shastras, the Shruti and the Smitri. The Shruti are ancient texts that include chants, hymns and Hindu teachings. The Smitri is a collection of poems and stories considered holy to Hindus. Hindus look to the Shastras for guidance about how to practice their religion. The Shastras are mostly written in the language Sanskrit.
